---
name: Cryptanalysis result
about: An attack, distinguisher, bound or correction to SPEC.md or ANALYSIS.md
title: "Cryptanalysis: "
labels: cryptanalysis
---

**Summary**

What is attacked (full hash, reduced number of steps, one absorption, the
fold, keyed or unkeyed) and what is obtained (collision, semi-free-start
or free-start collision, preimage, distinguisher, key recovery, bound).

**Complexity**

Time, data and memory, and whether the result is proven, measured or argued
(as in ANALYSIS.md).

**Details**

The method, or a link to a paper, preprint or code.

**Reproduction**

Explicit pairs or messages if any, and how to check them against this
repository (for example with `pikaseko256_steps`).

**Effect on ANALYSIS.md**

Which statement or margin this changes, if any.
